script_text: Aries, brace yourself — Mars fuels your fire this coming week with a surge of daring momentum for you. Monday: Mars in 6th house sextiles Jupiter in 3rd, sharpening dynamic work drive and communication. Tuesday: Venus enters 5th house, igniting exciting playful love vibes and a new romance. Thursday’s Sun conjunct Mars in your 10th house lights career ambition, giving confidence to lead. Friday Moon trines Uranus in your 11th house, bringing unexpected social invites and fresh ideas. Saturday warns Venus opposes Neptune in your 2nd house — avoid grandiose money schemes, stay grounded. Thursday is power day: Sun conjunct Mars in your 10th house amplifies leadership and career drive. Wednesday is toughest: Mercury squares Saturn in your 1st house, causing self‑doubt and delays. Use Mars‑Jupiter sextile to launch a new project blending bold action with clear communication, multiplying opportunities. Follow for daily updates.
